verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway documents plugins for request/response transformations and extensibility through modules and plugins. That gives it its own mechanism to run logic before requests are proxied and after responses return, and to reshape data. The evidence is only a one-line mention, with no detail on scripting, and nothing shows chaining requests or using captured response values in later calls. missing for 10: documented user scripting for pre-request/post-response hooks, request chaining with variable passing, CI-oriented scripting workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
